description: An indented closing marker also ends a << heredoc
notes: The spec allows spaces before the closing marker only for heredocs introduced with <<-, which suggests that an indented marker line doesn't end a << heredoc, leaving it unterminated. hashicorp/hcl compares each candidate line with its leading and trailing Unicode whitespace removed by bytes.TrimSpace, for both heredoc forms (the heredocLiteralEOL action in hclsyntax/scan_tokens.rl).
